description: Use when an agent has to decide whether what it just read on-chain is fresh, or whether a node is behind: the latest block height, its timestamp and how many seconds old the chain head is. Do not use for one transaction's outcome (/v1/evm/tx) or to compare several chains at once (/v1/evm/chains does all of them in one call). Flat price, no rate limits, no API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).
